t: Building the Ghost Driver: Automated Self-Testing for Agentic AI
s: This article details the development of a 'Ghost Driver' for agentic AI, enabling autonomous web application self-testing. It focuses on 'Calibrated Calibration'—refining a JSON test script to provide truthful, minimal assertions for initial workflow steps like pipeline ID submission, moving beyond over-promising.
sub: Ghost Driver for autonomous web UI testing
Ouroboros of Sovereignty: AI system builds/tests itself
Calibrated Calibration: truthful test assertions over optimistic reports
Unix pipes analogy for AI workflow development
